meta.title: beautifulreact — Async Delivery: the query cache

cards.title: There is no client-side outbox
items: the outbox role is adapted here: a browser has no durable queue, so nothing is enqueued for later delivery and no message survives a reload
the query cache is in-memory only — a reload starts from an empty cache and the ViewModel asks again
durability belongs to the server, which owns the authoritative state; the client is a reader with a cache, not a writer with a spool

cards.title: The query layer owns the async path
items: cache, revalidation, deduplication, retries and background refresh belong to the query layer (TanStack Query or the SDK's cache), not to a useEffect per component
the query key is the cache identity: stable, serializable and carrying every input — ["leads", tenantId, { cursor, search }]
after a mutation, invalidate by prefix (["leads"]); do not refetch the world

cards.title: Optimistic writes need a rollback
items: cancel the in-flight query for the affected key, snapshot the previous cache value, write the optimistic value, send the mutation
on success write the server's answer; on failure restore the snapshot and show the error — without the snapshot and the restore it is data loss with a spinner
rateLimited maps to retry with Retry-After; network and server errors map to a retryable error state

cards.title: Cancellation is part of the contract
items: a manual useEffect fetch needs an AbortController, a cleanup and a guard against setting state after unmount; the query layer owns all three
the SDK method is typed and takes an abort signal, so a route change cancels the request instead of racing it
errors are values: the SDK normalizes the envelope into a typed union, the ViewModel maps each code to a screen state
